status: Completed optimistic bulk-metal conduction screens; not full heat balance

limits: Ideal prescribed-temperature bore-wall layer and isothermal pool; optimistic bulk-metal delivery only, not operating temperatures or finite heater power.
No heater contact/interface resistance, external losses, cable/mount cooling, wire-feed melting, phase change, convection, transient heat capacity or Joule heat.
Fixed k and one0.1mm grid. Assumed pool loads illustrate thermal resistance; no actual feed demand has been established.
Air, magnets and floating heater/sensor sheaths are thermally omitted. Temperature is prescribed directly in the steel bore-wall layer; no sheath/interface contact is inferred from sub-cell gaps.
native.method: Existing GPU finite-volume scalar operator with k; selected steel heater-bore wall cells +0.5K, entire liquid pool -0.5K, other exterior adiabatic
